name: tekgeek88/Homework-5-Machine-Assembly-Languages
description: An assembly language program to simulate a simple guessing game. The program has stored the value 6. The program will continually ask the user to guess a number between 0 and 9 (see sample program input/output below.). If your program encounters any non-digit character, the program should output Invalid input. Invalid input should still count as a guess. User enters input and hits enter. The ASCII code x0A causes the cursor to go to the next line (Newline). Name your file Guess.asm. Assume that the user gets it right within 9 guesses.
